services.name: Mother's Day Cruise
services.desc: Celebrate Mother's Day With a 1hr Cruise and Early Entry with a Guaranteed table at The Point for brunch. From 9:30am - 10:30am Included In Your Cruise 1hr Cruise on the Magothy River Early entry into The Point with a GUARANTEED table at Opening Rise Up Coffee Pack your drink of choice its BYOB FAQs Only 30 tickets available (sold out in 2hrs last year) All cruises leave from The Point Bathroom Aboard Price is $65/ticket Must be on the cruise in order to get early entry into Guaranteed Seating @ The Point • All Ages! • 1 Hour • Public Cruise • Up to 30 People

services.name: Private Cruise - Baby K
services.desc: Private Cruise Aboard the Baby K Join us aboard the Baby K, a 21-foot Privateer center console, for an unforgettable private cruise experience. Whether you're planning a celebration or simply looking to explore the Chesapeake Bay in style, the Baby K is perfect for intimate outings and small-group adventures. Perfect for Any Occasion The Baby K can accommodate up to 6 passengers, making it ideal for a wide variety of private excursions, including: -Tubing & Wakeboarding -Swimming & Sandbar Trips -Restaurant Cruises -Crabbing Adventures -Photography & Drone Tours -Baltimore or Annapolis City All Ages! • Up to 6 People • Best Value

services.name: Private Cruise - Samantha Belle
services.desc: Private Cruise Aboard the Samantha Belle Join us aboard the Samantha Belle, a 46-foot traditional Chesapeake-style deadrise workboat, for an unforgettable private cruise experience. Whether you’re planning a celebration or simply looking to explore the Chesapeake Bay in style, the Samantha Belle is perfect for events large and small. Perfect for Any Occasion The Samantha Belle can accommodate up to 30 passengers comfortably, making it ideal for a wide array of private events, including: Bachelor & Bachelorette Parties Lunch or Dinner Cruises Sunset Cruises Birthday Parties & Anniversaries All Ages! • Up to 30 People • Sunset Cruises Available!

services.name: Public Weekly Sunset Cruise
services.desc: Our Popular Sunset Cruise! Great option for small and large groups. One Hour The Details Book a cruise with a licensed Captain to see the sunset on the Magothy River. We welcome everyone of all ages on our public cruises. There is a restroom aboard. Bring your own food, drinks, alcohol, anything you want to bring is welcome. The capacity is 24 for these public cruises. First come first served. All cruises leave from Ferry Point Marina in Arnold BEST VALUE • All Ages! • 1 Hour • Public Cruise • Up to 24 People
